idea: A tired barista finds a note in the tip jar: "Meet me where it started."

script.title: Closing Note
script.logline: Closing up an empty cafe, an exhausted barista unfolds a mysterious note from the tip jar that upends her night.
script.setting: A dimly lit neighborhood cafe counter after hours, with faint amber streetlights reflecting off stainless steel espresso pipes.

character.name: Maya
character.look: Twenty-four-year-old woman with tired hazel eyes, messy dark bun, faded green apron over a black thermal shirt, and a silver nose stud.

shots.visual: Maya counts cash from a glass tip jar, freezing as her fingers pull out a tightly creased paper napkin scrap.
shots.motion: Maya's hands slowly unfold the crumpled note, her brow furrowing with sudden intensity.

shots.visual: Maya's face fills the frame, her eyes scanning the handwriting before she gazes up toward the dark front entrance.
shots.motion: Her eyes widen as she whispers the line aloud, a tremor running through her breath.
